name: sparsew2t data: Baostock A-shares (delisting-inclusive) + CSRC case parse
command: set -eo pipefail; D=$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR; mkdir -p $D/ashare_bs $D/csrc; echo 0/3 > $D/progress.txt; echo '[1/3] baostock'; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python scripts/data_fetch/fetch_ashare_bs.py --out $D/ashare_bs --procs 4 2>&1 | grep -E 'universe|fetched|FAILED|rows' | tail -n 30; echo 1/3 >> $D/progress.txt; test -s $D/ashare_bs/daily_bars.csv || { echo 'no daily_bars.csv'; exit 1; }; echo '[2/3] parse CSRC'; cp /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/data/csrc/csrc_decisions.jsonl $D/csrc/; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python scripts/data_fetch/parse_csrc.py --decisions $D/csrc/csrc_decisions.jsonl --universe $D/ashare_bs/universe.csv --out $D/csrc 2>&1 | tail -n 12; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python scripts/data_fetch/split_csrc_sheet.py $D/csrc/csrc_sheet_auto.csv 365 2008-03-01 2>&1; echo 2/3 >> $D/progress.txt; rm -rf $D/ashare_bs/cache; echo '[3/3] done'; echo 3/3 >> $D/progress.txt; touch $D/DONE_ashare
